summary: Wrote a 4-phase plan for injecting a literal [repo:<slug>] tag into the provenance of pending Sapience capture KOs. Phase 1 authors an extension-owned sapience-tag-pending.sh that rewrites ~/.sapience/pending_kos.jsonl under the vendor's own ledger flock, resolving each record's slug via capture.projects[].name -> path_prefix -> the shared resolve_checkout_toplevel() block -> basename; Phase 2 adds a fixture-driven suite and extends the byte-identity lockstep guard; Phase 3 corrects the domain docs' population census and documents the sync -> tag -> review sequencing; Phase 4 redeploys and runs the scoped touched-path check, deferring the full gate set to the orchestration close. Backfill of already-uploaded untagged KOs is a declared non-goal (create and read are the vault's only KO operations), and no phase mutates the live ledger or posts to the vault.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan: tagging script, fixture test suite plus lockstep registration, corrected population census, redeploy and scoped gate sweep.

user_decision.question: Should the implementation phase run the new tagging script against the live ~/.sapience/pending_kos.jsonl (3757 pending records across nvim, .dotfiles and sapience-app), or stop at shipping and fixture-testing the script and leave the live pass and the subsequent `sapience review` post to you?
options: Ship and fixture-test only - the plan verifies with a read-only dry-run against the live ledger and hands you the operator command sequence; no record is mutated and nothing is posted to the vault

Also run the live pass - the implementation phase runs `--write` against the real ledger, tagging all 3757 pending records including 1687 belonging to the .dotfiles checkout and 810 to sapience-app, still without posting
user_decision.recommended: Ship and fixture-test only - the plan verifies with a read-only dry-run against the live ledger and hands you the operator command sequence; no record is mutated and nothing is posted to the vault
user_decision.obligation: Keep every mutation inside this repository's declared write surface: the ledger lives under ~/.sapience/ (outside it), the tagging pass would rewrite records captured from two other checkouts, and the `sapience review` step that makes a tag permanent is a user-driven GNOME launcher surface with no delete or update API behind it.
